**Texere 0.4.20** · 13 November 2026

- **The note scrolls to each new highlight**, whether it's open in Source, Live Preview or Reading view, and even if it has just opened.

Also in this version (from 0.4.19 and earlier): the PDF no longer reloads (no white flash) when you highlight or delete a highlight; new versions are shown on the home page, never installed by themselves; Zotero citations with an optional PDF; the pointer in PDFs; faster highlights.

Update: the **Update** button on Texere's home page, or BRAT at startup.
